text:
ops_bot: :rotating_light: Paging: cont-batch path p99 spike (>2500ms) in us-west2 - model-reranker-prod (streaming). Triggered by pack_shed and KV-eviction churn. Auto-paged to #eng-oncall.

sre_oncall: ACK, I'm online. grabbing traces and recent scheduling events.

rachel: Grafana: p95 steady ~180ms, p99 jumped from 600ms -> 2.6s in last 8m. Streaming stalls showing as stalled reads in runtime logs.

pavan: I see a surge of long-seq (>= 3000 tokens) requests starting ~5m before alert, lots from a handful of clients. Mixed-seqlen batching likely causing head-of-line blocking.

tan: Any recent scheduler changes? I rolled out a packing tweak to prefer fuller slots yesterday night but only to staging. No prod rollout today.

leo: There was an infra autoscaler blip earlier that drained a node in usw2-hotpool for 45s, could have caused temporary hotter KV eviction. infra_bot: node-drain event id=nd-2026-09-11-07

chris: Customer impact check: a few Dedicated tenants reported increased reconnection events and slow streaming frames; CS flagged two support cases.

sre_oncall: Immediate mitigations to reduce tail: 1) temporarily enable seqlen_preempt on cont-batch scheduler, 2) drop batch_max from 32->14 for this pool, 3) route streaming clients with low qos to reranker-ll variant. Which do we want first?

rachel: Let's do (2) and (1) in that order; smaller batches cut queuing; preempt avoids long seqs blocking. I'll apply.

rachel: Running command: 
```
opsctl update-pool --region usw2 --pool cont-batch --max-batch 14 --set seqlen_preempt=true
```

rachel: Applied to 8/10 nodes, rolling remainder.

infra_bot: Note: suppressed autoscaler for pool cont-batch in usw2 for 10m to avoid oscillation.

pavan: I'll add a temporary router rule for streaming: 40% traffic -> model-reranker-prod-ll (quantized, lower mem) for client_tier=free. Command: `routerctl apply route --from model-reranker-prod --to model-reranker-prod-ll --percent 40 --streaming`

chris: Throttled an internal test harness that was spiking long prompts. `quotactl set test-harness-9 --rps 2` done.

rachel: Early effect: p99 dropped to ~1.1s over 6m, streaming stall fraction down from 12% -> 4.2%. Good.

sre_oncall: Collecting tail traces now. Can we capture top 50 traces by latency and annotate with seq_len/client?

pavan: Doing a trace-sample run: `tracectl sample --pool cont-batch --top 50 --annot seq_len,client_id`

leo: Found a correlation: KV-evict spikes on nodes that got drained earlier. Eviction churn increases latency variance for replicas serving long KV chains. We'll add smoothing to eviction TTL.

chris: For customer comms: recommend a short update: "We observed intermittent elevated tail latency in us-west2 affecting streaming for a small set of customers. We've applied routing and batch config changes which mitigated immediate impact; engineers are investigating root cause and will follow up." Any objections?

sre_oncall: Fine. Add that we're monitoring and include timeframe.

rachel: Handing active oncall to pavan in 8m for follow-up; I'll stay on triage thread.

pavan: Taking lead. I'll keep tracking and coordinate postmortem. First tasks: keep collect traces for 30m, confirm no regression after re-enable autoscaler, and check Dedicated tenants for SLA hits.

leo: Quick note: we should also consider a seqlen-aware batching heuristic that caps the batch occupancy by token budget instead of request count to avoid oversized token batches. I'll open an RFC.

sre_oncall: Created incident INF-5001: "cont-batch tail p99 due to mixed-seqlen packing and KV eviction churn" assigned to eng-runtime. Link: https://redwood.example/INF-5001

chris: CS update drafted: "Between 07:02-07:28 UTC today we saw elevated streaming tail latencies in us-west2 due to mixed-length request packing and eviction churn. We applied temporary routing and batching config changes which reduced tail latency; engineering is implementing scheduler fairness and eviction smoothing to prevent recurrence. No customer data loss." Approving.

pavan: Follow-ups: 1) eng-runtime to implement seqlen-aware packing + preemptive small request hedging (owner leo). 2) infra to add KV-eviction smoothing on drain events (owner leo/infra). 3) ops to add rate limits for internal test harnesses and a KIP to block runaway long-seq clients automatically. 4) CS to notify affected Dedicated tenants if SLA impact >20m.

leo: I'll start a design doc for token-budgeted batching and eviction smoothing and attach load repro steps. ETA initial draft 72h.

sre_oncall: Monitoring: p95 ~170ms, p99 ~850ms, streaming stalls ~1.7% and trending down. If stable for 20m we'll close the page.

infra_bot: Page logged and tagged for postmortem. Participants: sre_oncall,rachel,pavan,leo,chris.

pavan: I'll keep monitoring for 25m then close if stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops_bot: :white_check_mark: Page closed by pavan at 07:40 UTC after sustained p99 < 1s for 20m. Postmortem scheduled in 72h.
